description: A drum voice built from a chaotic bit pattern generator, with a slow random walk laid over its rate

params.text: Sets the decay of the burst within the band picked by the switch below it
Picks one of three decay bands: up to 26ms, 30ms to 200ms, or 200ms to 4000ms
Sets the rate of the bit pattern generator, which changes both the pitch and the pattern of the screech

inputs.text: A gate above 0.5V restarts the decay
Adds to the rate setting, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt

outputs.text: The drum voice, with the extreme top and bottom of the spectrum filtered away

inputs.0: high above 0.5V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1:
±5V · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
